comparison.objective: Remove exactly one chip from an open packet and place it on a plate while leaving two inside; candidate removes one specified terminal from a connector.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests selective grasping from a confined opening and gentle transfer. Candidate tests tool-mediated latch depression, constrained insertion, and opposing wire/tool forces.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires exactly one chip extracted and stable on the plate, other chips contained, packet stable, and hands clear. Candidate requires the selected terminal extracted, adjacent terminals retained, crimp intact, and no housing/tool damage.
comparison.reason: Both demand selective extraction, but PR tests direct grasp-and-transfer of loose contents; it does not test mechanical latch release, sustained tool engagement, or bimanual depinning.
